reason: The orthorhombic cell (about 5.825 x 8.207 x 5.796 A), Z=1, and a perovskite-derived average framework are well supported, and the submitted CIF is compositionally and chemically plausible. Exact recovery is not sufficiently established, however. The comparable whole-pattern report supplies no score, while the claimed 0.0465 mismatch is an unweighted self-calculated norm from an ad hoc pseudo-Voigt profile rather than an independently comparable Rwp. Recalculation shows a residual RMS of about 0.142 against baseline noise of about 0.097 (reduced chi-square about 2 if that noise is used), with systematic residuals at major and minor reflection features. After indexing the correct cell, the trajectory essentially refined one Pnma-derived, one-cell Ti/Zr ordering with many Sr/O degrees of freedom in P-1; it did not quantitatively instantiate and compare distinct correct-cell symmetry, disorder/order, or larger-period ordering candidates. The statement that four parent B-site choices are symmetry-equivalent only removes relabelings conditional on that chosen parent and cell. Thus the cell and average framework have stronger support than the submitted P-1 coordinates and element ordering, and another scientifically focused attempt is warranted.
